body.x: [Pipeline Position] Operations Specialist (Kenya Country Office) [Based in Nairobi]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Operations Specialist for a 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Kenya Country Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Nairobi, Kenya. (Duty station: Nairobi, Kenya)

This job is responsible for providing administrative management support to the Kenya Country Office (KCO) team and contributing to IVI’s administrative processes and activities to ensure efficient and compliant operation of the business. The role is broad with a variety of tasks, covering everything from administrative tasks to solving other daily needs within the staff and business. The Operations Specialist has a significant role in building up the administrative processes of KCO and provides ad-hoc project administration support as needed.
1. Responsible for operational activities in KCO
Provide administrative operational support and guidance to staff, including onboarding of new staff to IVI SOPs and processes.
Support developing operating and capital budgets and monitor expenses according to the allotted budget.
Maintain accurate and clear documentation for operational procedures and activities, including records such as the KCO risk and asset registers.
Ensure legal and regulatory documents comply with local laws and regulations, are reported to the appropriate management level as needed and properly filed.

Maintains archiving of all relevant documents and communication related to Finance, Procurement & Travel, Human Resources, and IT departments activities and any other relevant KCO activities as requested.
Build alliances and partnerships with back-office functions in IVI Headquarters to achieve optimal operations (Finance, Procurement & Travel, Human Resources, IT).
Raise and track issues and conflicts, remove barriers, resolve issues of medium complexity involving stakeholders and escalate to appropriate level when required.
Supports back-office and institutional-wide training programs, reinforcing operations infrastructure between teams to ensure consistency and quality standards are met.
Support the implementation of new processes and procedures.
Support maintaining, developing, updating and archiving standard operating procedures for all business operational activities.
Provide recommendations and suggestions for improvements in any aspects relating to institutional policies and procedures to ensure compliance with local laws and regulations as needed
Optimizing operational processes and procedures for maximum efficiency while maintaining quality standards.
3. Act as an operational focal point for KCO
Representative of the operational project/activities for Finance, HR, Procurement & Travel, and IT in the KCO.
Local Monitoring and management of the outsourcing of Finance & Operations Unit activities in Kigali as decided by the heads of the relevant administrative functions located in IVI Headquarters
Provide logistic/administrative support in arranging meetings, conferences, workshops etc. in KCO as requested.
Internal Control contact person in KCO
Grant administration: Support grant administration, including sub-awards, sub-grants, collaborations, and coordination with Finance for grant initiation and closing.

Project/budget administration: Maintain approved project budgets, monitor project expenditures, support budget and expenditure projections, and prepare financial reports in accordance with IVI and/or sponsor guidelines.
Logistics and administration: Provide logistical and administrative support for project activities, including procurement, meetings, workshops, disbursement of project funds, and project archiving.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. Finance, accounting training is a plus.
5+ years’ experience with at least 3 years in an administrative position in an international setting with experience in process improvement and SOP development.
Ability to manage multiple deliverables in parallel and to prioritize.
Ability to take on tasks and duties without immediate direction.
Good organizational, data management and documentation skills.
Fluency in English. Working knowledge of French, Portuguese, or Arabic would be an advantage.
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
